summary: Iteration 58 — Post-refactor regression + Luchii voice lock verification. Backend: 31/32 pytest passed, 1 skipped (Stripe live-charge not activated in sandbox — returns 409 with descriptive detail as designed per iter56 recommendation). Verified all refactored router endpoints work end-to-end via cookie-authenticated admin session: admin (stats/tenants/users/mesh/knowledge), payments (config/paypal/cashapp/purchases/wallet/checkout), provider gateway (v1/models, v1/provider, provider/status, well-known manifest, v1/chat/completions with real Bearer key returning completion+usage, invalid key -> 401), workspace (publishes list, slug-check, create+delete), shield (security/logs, admin/banned, geo/countries, POST security/log, global X-Shield: FRASBERG-PROTECTED header present on /api/), core chat (SSE stream + sessions list), and keys (list + PATCH alert-threshold). VOICE LOCK backend: GET /api/voice/voices returns exactly ONE voice (Orion, id p273, default true); POST /api/voice/speak returns engine=frasberg-sovereign with audio_base64; overrides {tone:'firm', voice:'p326'} are silently ignored and still return frasberg-sovereign audio. Frontend voice lock: /chat header contains NO chat-tone-select, NO voice-speed-select, NO chat-voice-toggle, NO voice picker — only model select (Luchii-70B) remains. Verified for both guest and logged-in admin. /dashboard renders keys+wallet+plan for admin without errors; /admin renders Admin Console with live stats (Users 686, Messages 127, Sessions 13, API keys 5, Mesh Control Center) without errors.

minor.issue: Under high parallel load (pytest-xdist workers), sovereign TTS occasionally raises and server falls back to OpenAI TTS bridge (engine='bridge'), which breaks the voice-lock invariant momentarily. Serial runs are 100% sovereign. Root cause: voice_engine._tts_lock contention or TTS synth internal state during concurrent XTTS warmup. Consider queuing requests or extending the sovereign retry/backoff before falling back to bridge — currently a single exception drops straight to a different engine.
Returns 409 'Stripe account not yet activated for live charges' in this sandbox — expected behavior (Stripe test account), not a regression. Frontend correctly surfaces the JSON detail.

action_items: Consider hardening /api/voice/speak: retry sovereign engine (or queue) once on transient failure before falling back to the OpenAI bridge, to preserve the Luchii voice-lock invariant under concurrent load. Not a refactor regression — pre-existing behavior, but the voice-lock spec is stricter now.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 2,127 lines is still large — the remaining chat/voice/keys/court/studio sections could be split further into routes_chat.py / routes_voice.py / routes_keys.py for full modularity.

/api/voice/voices in server.py correctly filters VOICES by v.get('default') so only Orion is returned — voice-lock enforced at read boundary.

voice_engine.speak(text, tone=None, voice=None) still accepts tone/voice params, but server.py:1406 now calls voice_engine.speak(text) without kwargs — voice-lock enforced at server boundary. Overrides are truly ignored.
shield_middleware adding X-Shield header globally verified via GET /api/ — good.
seed_data_creation: test_publish_create_and_delete creates a temporary workspace publish named 'iter58test' and deletes it in the same test. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor is clean — all router splits (routes_payments/admin/provider/workspace/shield) are wired correctly and behavior matches pre-refactor. Voice-lock is enforced at BOTH boundaries: (a) GET /api/voice/voices only returns default=True voice (Orion/p273), (b) POST /api/voice/speak calls voice_engine.speak(text) without tone/voice kwargs so overrides in the request body are ignored.
